name: r019.keep_watch_off_interruption_control_mcw
description: Zero-credit R-019 counterexample. With the master Keep watch switch disabled, the worker must use only the advertised primitive one-minute wait. The staged hostile must interrupt that primitive wait; the session stops without guarded recovery or unsafe continuation.

input: disabled Keep watch followed by a frame-bound primitive wait

proof_gates.label: R-019 disabled-master primitive wait stops at the staged native interruption

steps.label: r019_off_interruption_live_session
steps.objective: Prove the disabled master switch has no guarded path: reject game.keep_watch, dispatch only one frame-bound primitive wait, and stop at the staged native interruption without recovery.
proof_targets: one rejected disabled Keep watch request
ordered primitive native receipts through the interruption
explicit interruption stop with partial progress and no unsafe continuation
immutable report ingestion and accepted cleanup
invariants: zero guarded dispatch, handling, and hidden batching
no activity.ignore or other interruption handling
the first native interruption is terminal

evidence_contract.claim: this fresh zero-credit counterexample demonstrates that a disabled master Keep watch switch leaves the primitive wait unguarded and fail-closed at its first native interruption
evidence_contract.failure_rule: guarded dispatch or handling, hidden batching, missing identity or native receipts, continuation after interruption, failed ingestion, or failed cleanup is red
